config.label: Long-lived Instagram access token: an IGAA
config.description: Long-lived Instagram access token: an IGAA... token on instagram_login, or a long-lived Page or User token with the instagram_* scopes on facebook_login.

config.label: Which Meta API path to use
config.description: Which Meta API path to use. instagram_login needs no Facebook Page (37 tools). facebook_login needs a linked Page and adds hashtag search, business discovery, Page listing and media deletion (42 tools).

config.label: Instagram professional account ID
config.description: Instagram professional account ID. Optional on instagram_login; required on facebook_login (find it with instagram_list_pages).

config.label: Meta app ID
config.description: Meta app ID. Needed only for instagram_get_token_info and instagram_refresh_token on facebook_login.

config.label: Meta app secret
config.description: Meta app secret. Needed only for instagram_get_token_info and instagram_refresh_token on facebook_login.
